organizer: International Astronautical Federation (IAF), with the International Academy of Astronautics (IAA) and International Institute of Space Law (IISL); each edition co-organized with a national host / Local Organizing Committee

submission.type: abstract-only for selection (max 400 words, no tables/drawings), followed by full manuscript for the proceedings after acceptance
submission.typical_abstract_deadline: 28 February (23:59 CET) of the congress year; IAF has frequently extended by about one week into early March
submission.typical_final_deadline: mid-September, 2-3 weeks before the congress (14 Sep 2026 for IAC 2026; 20 Sep 2027 for IAC 2027)
submission.notes: Abstracts submitted via https://iafastro.directory/iac/account/login/; IPC final selection at IAF Spring Meetings (March, Paris); notification mid/late April. Papers enter the proceedings only if presented in person. No page limit for the final manuscript was verified.
